description_en: Modifies the configuration of a VPC firewall for a transit router. Before you call this operation, create a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) Enterprise Edition transit router and then call CreateTrFirewallV2 to create a VPC firewall for the transit router. You can obtain the FirewallId and then call this operation
description_zh: 修改TR防火墙配置。【前置依赖】CEN 企业版转发路由器 → CreateTrFirewallV2 创建 TR 防火墙 → 获取 FirewallId 后调用本 API
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-tr-firewall-v2-configuration --lang zh --firewall-id vfw-tr-bcdf89d405ce4bd20000 --firewall-name vpc-firewall --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyTrFirewallV2Configuration

parameters.help_en:
The language of the content within the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.

FirewallId and FirewallName are both required. If either is not provided, an ErrorParameters(400) error is returned. You can call DescribeTrFirewallsV2List to obtain the FirewallId
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例ID。

FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，未同时提供返回 ErrorParameters(400)。FirewallId 可通过 DescribeTrFirewallsV2List 获取
parameters.name: firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance name of the virtual private cloud (VPC) firewall.
FirewallId and FirewallName are both required. If either is not provided, an ErrorParameters(400) error is returned
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙实例名。
FirewallId 与 FirewallName 联合必填，未同时提供返回 ErrorParameters(400)
parameters.name: firewall_name
